cohort: The study included 486 infants receiving two doses of Rotarix across India (n=307), Malawi (n=119), and the UK (n=60).
finding: Oral rotavirus vaccine (ORV) shedding and seroconversion rates were significantly lower in Malawi and India compared to the UK, with maternal rotavirus-specific antibodies and increased microbiota diversity negatively correlated with ORV response in India and Malawi.
